options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:

options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Required Secret Disks
options.doc:
Number of Secret Disks required to unlock the final stage.

The Abandoned Research Laboratory opens once every other stage has been cleared and
you are holding this many disks. Clearing it completes the game.
options.doc_fr:
Nombre de disques secrets requis pour débloquer l'étape finale.

Le laboratoire de recherche abandonné ouvre une fois que toutes les autres étapes ont été nettoyées et vous tenez ces nombreux disques. La compensation complète le jeu.

options.name: Final Stage Rank
options.doc:
The rank you need to get on each stage for the final stage to open, in addition to the required disks.

F means that clearing each stage will automatically unlock the boss.
None means no stage has to be cleared at all, and the final stage opens as soon as you hold the required secret disks.

options.name: Extra Life Sanity
options.doc: Makes every 1-UP pickup a location check (10 in total).
options.doc_fr: Fait chaque ramassage 1-UP un contrôle de localisation (10 au total).

options.name: Itemsanity
options.doc: Makes every static energy and E-Crystal pickup a location check (82 in total).
options.doc_fr: Fait de chaque énergie statique et E-Crystal pickup un contrôle d'emplacement (82 au total).

options.name: Shop Price Scale
options.doc:
How expensive Cerveau's shop is, as a percentage.

Items range from 70 to 700 eCrystals, with most being in the 100 to 300 range.
options.doc_fr:
Combien coûte la boutique de Cerveau, en pourcentage.

Les articles vont de 70 à 700 eCrystals, la plupart étant de la gamme 100 à 300.

options.name: Randomize Enemies (WIP)
options.doc:
Randomize each enemy spawn location.
WARNING: VERY EARLY WORK IN PROGRESS. DO NOT TAKE INTO BIG MULTIWORLDS!
This mode is very buggy, see the readme section to know what to expect.
Recommended to enable enemy disk markers!
options.doc_fr:
Randomiser chaque emplacement de frai ennemi.
WARNING: Très tôt, ça marche. NE PAS PRENDRE DANS LES GRANDS MULTIWORLDS!
Ce mode est très buggy, voir la section readme pour savoir à quoi s'attendre.
Recommandé pour activer les marqueurs de disque ennemis!

options.name: Randomized Enemy Difficulty (WIP)
options.doc:
Only applies if `randomize_enemies` is enabled. Higher difficulties put more enemies in the spot for one, based off of the health of the spot being replaced.
Minimal: Tries to match enemy placements by health. If a less health enemy replaces one with more health, place multiple copies at that location.
Chaos: Places multiple enemies around every spawnpoint regardless of HP or enemy type. Leads to many more enemies per stage. Developer's choice!
Insanity: Places as many enemies as possible. Tries to prioritize enemies with higher HP. Expect many shield enemies in tight quarters. Good luck!
options.doc_fr:
S'applique uniquement si `randomize_enemies` est activé. Plus de difficultés mettent plus d'ennemis sur place pour un, basé sur la santé de l'endroit étant remplacé.
Minimal: Essaie de faire correspondre les placements ennemis par la santé. Si un ennemi de moins de santé remplace un autre par plus de santé, placer plusieurs copies à cet endroit.
Chaos: Place plusieurs ennemis autour de chaque point de frai, peu importe HP ou type ennemi. Conduit à beaucoup plus d'ennemis par étape. Le choix du développeur !
Insanity: Lieux autant d'ennemis que possible. Essaie de prioriser les ennemis avec HP supérieur. S'attendre à de nombreux ennemis de bouclier dans les quartiers serrés. Bonne chance !

options.name: Starting Weapons
options.doc:
Which weapons Zero starts with.
The weapon will still start at its first tier, and progressive unlocks (charge attacks and saber combos) will need to be unlocked.
If this is left empty, one random weapon is granted instead.

Valid Keys: {"Buster", "Z-Saber", "Recoil Rod", "Shield Boomerang"}

options.name: Weapon Damage Upgrades
options.doc:
Whether the last three steps of each progressive weapon raise its damage.

A few players disliked this feature since it departed the gameplay from vanilla.

WIP: Disabling this still keeps the extra three progressive weapon items in the pool, 
they just don't provide any bonuses.

options.name: Cyber-elves
options.doc:
Modifications to Cyber Elf usage. Satellite elves remain unmodified.

Vanilla: Unmodified Vanilla. Upgrading elves cost eCrystals, fusion elves decrease rank.
No Penalty: Fusing an elf does not affect rank.
Auto: Every passive elf received via disk is automatically opened and applied. 
Does not affect rank. Gives the game a nice sense of progression, but makes it a lot easier.
options.doc_fr:
Modifications à l'utilisation de Cyber Elf. Les elfes satellites ne sont pas modifiés.

Vanilla: Vanille non modifiée. La modernisation des elfes coûte eCrystals, fusion elfes diminue le rang.
No Penalty: La fusion d'un elfe n'affecte pas le rang.
Auto: Chaque elfe passif reçu par disque est automatiquement ouvert et appliqué.
N'affecte pas le grade. Donne au jeu un bon sens de progression, mais le rend beaucoup plus facile.

options.name: EX Skill Rank
options.doc:
The rank a stage clear needs in order to send that stage's EX Skill check. In the vanilla game it would be an A.

The rank is for the mission just finished, not your overall rank. F sends the check on any clear.

options.doc: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
